arrival.rule: Arrival mismatch = predicted arrival HR (intrinsic + the saturated acute and debt increments the arrival physiology produces, derived.heart_rate_decomposition) - authored arrival HR, in bpm, signed. No tolerance exists, so none is applied: the distribution is reported, binned by |mismatch| at 1 / 5 / 10 / 20 bpm for presentation only (1 bpm is the authored resolution). ANALYTIC_REJECTION only for a domain violation (a sinus base rate at or above the ceiling); a mismatch is never a rejection here.

decision_surface.note: no committed numeric HR band exists; nothing here is an envelope or a target

ceiling.rule: Three sinus-rate ceilings, 150 / 175 / 200 bpm: the broad adult maximal-sinus-rate range (about 150 for an older adult to about 200 for a young adult, the span of the age-predicted maximum over adult ages; general physiology, not repository truth) and its midpoint. HR_RESERVE = ceiling - sinus base rate. Checked before any run: every ceiling lies above every authored GI arrival HR and every intrinsic level (the authored arrival stays reachable), and at every (ceiling, intrinsic) the smallest authored arrival sympathetic share is read almost linearly (saturation takes off less than the authored HR resolution, 1 bpm). Never read: legacy HR, any trajectory.

faculty.acute_signal: the effective oxygen deficit (over demand) is the acute shock signal; no absolute-pressure reference; the relative-pressure term may stay if it does not double count (audited)
faculty.d_scale: D's absolute scale is not approved: debt_to_sympathetic_gain is read with it (D x c, gain / c leaves HR unchanged); the arrival-debt support is propagated uncertainty, never an anchor
faculty.intrinsic: 60 / 80 / 100 stays STILL_VALID_CANDIDATE_RANGE; no value approved; cancellation is not equivalence
faculty.saturation: a smooth monotone saturation of the sympathetic increment (no hard clip); no final reserve
faculty.scope: shadow only; no pressure, RR or numeric HR calibration, no collapse, GI migration, second family or runtime integration; no hidden parameter approved
faculty.shock_recoverable: the shock part of arrival tachycardia is generated from the current state and resolves when shock resolves; no fixed case-specific offset; S0 is not forced to zero without replacing its causal role

composites.acute_increment_at_arrival: 25 x acute gain x arrival signal (bpm, unconstrained)
composites.arrival_hr: intrinsic + HR_RESERVE tanh(25 (acute gain x arrival signal + debt gain x D0) / HR_RESERVE), HR_RESERVE = ceiling - intrinsic: one equation per case
composites.debt_increment_at_arrival: 25 x debt gain x D0 (bpm, unconstrained; D scale latent)
composites.debt_over_time: debt gain x D(t) = debt gain x D0 x D(t) / D0: only gain x scale is observable

acute_deficit_to_sympathetic_gain.note: shares the arrival equation with the debt gain; it resolves with the deficit and the debt persists, so post-arrival HR would separate them; none is authored

debt_to_sympathetic_gain.note: only gain x D scale; D x c, gain / c gives the same HR
debt_to_sympathetic_gain.support: [0.000667, 0.16] and 0, on the current D support

intrinsic_sinus_rate.note: no longer an exact shift: through HR_RESERVE it changes the saturated increment (largest change of HR - intrinsic between levels at the anchor 3.85 bpm); not identifiable from the arrival HR alone

sinus_rate_ceiling_bpm.note: visible only where the increment approaches the reserve (high drive); the authored arrival shares sit in the near-linear range

statements.1: a larger effective deficit, all else fixed, never lowers HR
statements.2: a larger D, all else fixed, never lowers HR
statements.3: tau_D at fixed D leaves HR unchanged
statements.4: the acute contribution resolves when the effective deficit resolves
statements.5: D may keep a delayed tachycardia after the acute deficit resolves
statements.6: as D repays, the debt-driven contribution may fall
statements.7: haemostasis alone does not instantly normalize HR
statements.8: the crystalloid effect arises through physiology, not fluid identity
statements.9: the PRBC effect arises through physiology, not a fixed HR decrement
statements.10: high sympathetic drive approaches saturation smoothly
statements.11: no discontinuous HR jump at saturation
statements.12: the intrinsic rhythm and the rhythm state remain authoritative

legacy_reference.rule: LEGACY REFERENCE, NOT A CALIBRATION TARGET: the family engine's HR at 0, 15, 30, 60, 90 and 120 min, read after the verdict, never by the gain range, a flag, an invariant, identifiability or the verdict.

policy: Shadow only. The P2I-2AD representatives (its committed record) and synthetic probes, never the P2F region. No arrival residual: the arrival HR is predicted and its mismatch reported. Candidate points predeclared; HR post-processed exactly (validated, else stop); no Cartesian product with blood, fluid or lactate; no pressure, RR or lactate change; the legacy HR read after the verdict only; nothing selected or approved.

pressure.why: the term is a deviation from arrival (0 at arrival, negative above arrival pressure) of output x tone, and both it and the deficit fall with output, so in bleeding they rise together (partial double counting of one shock); it also carries what the deficit does not (tone, and pressure falling while extraction still compensates) and, above arrival pressure, unloads the drive while a deficit persists. Neither reads the drive (no circularity). Whether it stays, becomes absolute or is removed is a pressure-domain decision; it is neither removed nor recalibrated here.

residual.calculation: S0 = (authored arrival HR - intrinsic) / (25 (1 - beta)), less debt_to_sympathetic_gain x D0: solved so that the arrival HR reproduces the authored one exactly (P2E-1, P2F-1, AC1)
residual.stored: no state variable: derived.arrival_non_debt_drive (P2I-2AE) recomputed every minute from the anchors and added as a constant to sympathetic_target; before P2I-2AE, S0 itself inside the target
residual.why: a per-case constant solved from the authored HR to force exact arrival matching; it has no dynamics, so the shock tachycardia it carried never resolved when the shock did

scan_rule: On each of the 18 representative runs (3 tags x 2 cases x L1 / L2 / L3), post-processed, no further simulation: the one-dimensional slices through the anchor (acute gain over its five points and 0; debt gain likewise; ceiling 150 / 175 / 200; intrinsic lower / midpoint / upper) and the acute x debt plane (6 x 6) at the anchor's ceiling and intrinsic. The anchor is a reading point, not a selection. No Cartesian product with blood, fluid or lactate.

H2.title: crystalloid 2 L over 20 min with continued bleeding (L2)

H3.title: PRBC before haemostasis (L3, 2 units over 0-60 min, PPI)

H4.title: definitive management: haemostasis at 60 and restored adequacy (L3, 60-120 min)

validation.rule: HR reaches no output, delivery, D, lactate or RR. Each representative (tag, case, scenario) is simulated once by the full core; for any (intrinsic, acute gain, debt gain, ceiling) the drive is recomputed minute by minute from that run's acute signal (effective deficit over demand), pressure_rel, SpO2, glucose, D and rhythm with the core's own arithmetic, and HR = intrinsic + HR_RESERVE tanh(25 (1 - beta) drive / HR_RESERVE). Validated on full core reruns at the ends of every range (exact drive, HR, RR, D, lactate and haemodynamics), else the run stops.

faculty_inputs: envelopes on the observable trajectories above, per case
whether the intrinsic rate may differ by case (the two authored arrivals differ by 12 bpm while the gains are common)
the sinus-ceiling range (150-200 proposed here, general physiology)
whether the relative-pressure term stays (pressure domain)
next_design.method: filter the acute x debt x ceiling x intrinsic points (and their D support) against the faculty envelopes on observables, post-processed from the cached physiology; report survivors and composites, never one best set; latent gains are never approved directly
observables: HR response to crystalloid (end of bolus, 120)
HR response to each PRBC unit (30, 60)

verdict.rule: HR_STRUCTURE_READY_FOR_NUMERIC_FACULTY_CALIBRATION when every check holds: (1) no arrival residual (the core's source and the probe in which the authored HR reaches no dynamics); (2) the acute contribution is explicit and recoverable (the source; 0 at no deficit; no acute contribution after sustained adequacy in any read L3 run); (3) tau_D does not reach HR at fixed D; (4) D x c with gain / c gives the same HR; (5) smooth saturation (tanh, no clip) and no sinus HR at or above the ceiling anywhere; (6) the twelve directions pass; (7) D, lactate and RR unchanged (P2I-2AD record and every validation rerun); (8) no structural flag; and the post-processing agrees with the full core. Otherwise HR_STRUCTURE_NOT_READY with the first blocker. The arrival mismatch is reported for the faculty, never a gate; no numeric parameter needs to be identified.
